rows: Maintenance Procedure Information System
Generation Stations
Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: G-042-r0a
Equipment: Mechanical parts of the generator
Status: APPROVED
Issued to: Esna Power Station
Approval date: 02 December 2007
Procedure: Annual maintenance (I1-Y1)
Next review date: December 2012

This document sets out the steps for the annual maintenance of the mechanical parts of the generator. The first draft of the document was prepared and field-tested by Eng. Abd El-Salam Abd El-Hamid Metwally at Esna Power Station, endorsed by Eng. Abd El-Karim Moussa Ahmed: Manager of the Mechanical Maintenance Department at the station, approved by Eng. Youssef Mahmoud Aly: General Manager of Esna Power Station, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Osama Soliman Salem: General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Hydro Power Generation Company and Maintenance Procedure Information System Coordinator
Issue an approved work order; maintenance personnel must carry the occupational safety and health category card
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions and procedures, such as wearing the helmet and safety shoes, etc.
Ensure the work area is defined and the appropriate warning signs are placed
Ensure the unit is stopped and placed in maintenance mode
Occupational safety and health and personal protection tools
Suitable tool bag, tools for cleaning filters
Inspect the lubrication lines
Clean the filters of the high-pressure pump
Clean the filters of the bearing lubrication circuit
Inspect the oil coolers
Test a sample of the bearing lubricating oil
Visual inspection of the lubrication pumps, the pressure pump and the oil vapour extraction fan
Check the operation of the heaters in the lower and upper tanks
Inspect the oil flow indicators for each bearing
Check the oil levels in the unit lubrication tank
Inspect the generator air cooling water lines
Wash the generator air coolers
Inspect the cooling fans
Lubricate the generator air cooling pumps for each unit
Inspect the brake jacks and test their operation
Inspect the brake air lines
The generator inspection and cleaning works are carried out in accordance with the station's main equipment outage programmes
